headline: No scored news; the lines hold steady
body: A quiet day with no scored events. The only movement was the slow fade of earlier announcements, shifting a handful of endings by a few hundredths. Horizon Balance reads -2.36. Enslaved God, a boxed superintelligence owned by one player, still leads at 36.99, ahead of Libertarian Utopia at 25.47.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Descendants -0.06 and Protector God -0.05.
